subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Low-level runtime object support shared across subsystems: Direct3D surface buffers and the format-code factory that constructs them, network audio dispatch thunks, OS/CPU feature detection, and the version-adaptive math dispatch tables plus lookup-table set installed during startup.

summary: This packet groups 13 generic runtime-object functions into ten defensible classes. Direct3D surface support: DirectXSurfaceBuffer (staging reallocation on format mismatch), VertexColorRenderBuffer (vertex-array render buffer with 16-bit color packing), and DirectXSurfaceFactory (format-code dispatch to ~39 per-code constructors). Audio: NetworkAudioDispatch, three thunks that lazily initialize the shared table then tail-call a global slot. Startup dispatch-table support: OSVersionCapabilities (OS/CPU feature detection), SSEMathDispatchTable, SSEMathDispatchTableAlt, AMD3DNowMathDispatchTable (CPU-guarded with five slot overrides), ScalarMathDispatchTable, and FixedPointLookupTableSet. The four table initializers and the lookup-table allocator are all invoked by sub_50FEA7 during shared-table setup. All class boundaries are DERIVED proposals from validated IR; no ownership is CONFIRMED and slot semantics are inferred from routine names.

function_roles.role: Reallocate the staging surface buffer when the destination surface format (this+0x8) differs from the source surface format (*(*(this+0x8)+0x8)); records the matched format and new buffer pointer, failing with -2147024882 on allocation failure.

Allocate and initialize a render buffer: create the DirectX texture, compute the even-aligned vertex count, install the vtable, allocate and construct the 16-byte-stride vertex array, and select the packing field layout from the descriptor format tag.
Encode per-vertex floating-point RGBA colors into packed 16-bit channel words using YCbCr-like conversion coefficients, guarded by the work and enable flags and clearing the work flag when done.

Format/object factory dispatcher: read the format code at *(this+0x8)+0x4, allocate a per-code-sized surface object, store it at this+0x8, and invoke the per-code constructor; unrecognized codes return NULL.
Audio-subsystem dispatch thunk: lazily initialize the shared function table via sub_50FEA7(1u), then tail-call the implementation stored in the global slot off_5D7890.
Two-argument variant of the audio dispatch thunk: initialize the shared function table via sub_50FEA7(1u), then tail-call the implementation stored in the global slot off_5D7848.
Audio subsystem dispatch wrapper: call sub_50FEA7(1u) then perform an indirect call through the global function pointer off_5D787C and return its result.
Detect the OS platform and CPU SIMD feature set via GetVersionExA with CPUID-based fallbacks (Win9x or API failure) and IsProcessorFeaturePresent on NT.
Fill the alternate SSE math dispatch table (33 used dword slots) with SSE math routines; no guards, returns the table pointer.
Fill the SSE math dispatch table (34 used dword slots) with SSE math routines; no guards, returns the table pointer.
CPU-guarded fill of the 3DNow/MMX math dispatch table (57 slots) plus alternative overrides on five slots when further feature bits are set; returns the CPU feature flags.
Fill the eight-entry scalar math dispatch table (slots 0..7 at offsets 0x0..0x1C) and return the table base pointer.
Allocate four 1024-DWORD lookup tables through vtable slot 0 and fill them with arithmetic-progression sequences; returns the pointer one dword past the last written element.

classes.name: DirectXSurfaceBuffer
classes.responsibility: Staging surface buffer used during Direct3D texture upload. Holds a destination surface-format descriptor at this+0x8 (source format reached through *(*(this+0x8)+0x8)). From packet prose (offsets not in the allowed field set): the staging buffer pointer is stored at this+0x104C, the recorded matched format at this+0x1048, and the staging width is read from this+0x1058; the buffer is reallocated as 16*width bytes whenever the destination and source formats differ.

classes.name: VertexColorRenderBuffer
classes.responsibility: Render buffer holding a 16-byte-stride vertex array (this+0x106C) plus the state for packing per-vertex RGBA colors into 16-bit channel words: destination WORD base at this+0x18, source/destination stride products (this+0x1050 * this+0x1074, this+0x1054 * this+0x1080), the processed vertex range (this+0x1070 .. this+0x1078), the work and enable flags (this+0x108C, this+0x1090) and the two pack shift amounts (this+0x1094, this+0x1098). Installs vtable off_5ADBB8 at this+0x0; the descriptor at this+0x8 carries the format tag (0x59565955 selects one 8-vs-zero layout, otherwise the mirrored one). this+0x1088 is written by the allocator but is not in the packet's allowed field set.

classes.name: DirectXSurfaceFactory
classes.responsibility: Format-code factory for Direct3D surface/object creation. Reads the format code at *(this+0x8)+0x4, allocates a per-code size (4204, 4252 or 4292 bytes) via the shared allocator, stores the created object at this+0x8, and invokes one of ~39 per-code constructors selected through a jump table; unrecognized codes return NULL. Post-construction, when the object's dword at +0x10 is non-null the virtual method at vtable slot 3 (+12) is invoked. Called from D3DContextInit. The this-4 frame tag slot is a local artifact with unknown public meaning.

classes.name: NetworkAudioDispatch
classes.responsibility: Dispatch thunks into the network audio subsystem. Each thunk calls sub_50FEA7(1u) to lazily install the shared version-adaptive function table, then tail-calls a dedicated global dispatch slot (off_5D7890 for the six-argument entry, off_5D7848 for the two-argument variant, off_5D787C for the no-argument wrapper). The slot implementations are selected during table installation and are not identified in this packet.

classes.name: OSVersionCapabilities
classes.responsibility: Detects the OS platform and CPU SIMD feature set that selects which version-adaptive dispatch table gets installed. Uses GetVersionExA with a CPUID-based legacy path (CPUID3DNowDetection for feature 7, sub_50FD4E for SSE feature 6/10) when the platform is Win9x or the API fails, and IsProcessorFeaturePresent for other features on NT.

classes.name: SSEMathDispatchTable
classes.responsibility: Function-pointer table of SSE math routines (vector sums and normalization, linear/cubic/hermite/bezier/bilinear spline interpolation, Newton-Raphson reciprocal and normalize refinement, 3x3 rotation-matrix multiply, triangle closest-point/normal, vector blend/lerp). Fills 34 used dword slots at offsets 0x0..0xD8. The owning object and dispatch convention are not evidenced.

classes.name: SSEMathDispatchTableAlt
classes.responsibility: Alternate function-pointer table of SSE math routines, sharing most slot assignments with SSEMathDispatchTable but differing at slots 7, 13, 16, 21, 24, 25, 27, 28 and 44. Fills 33 used dword slots at offsets 0x0..0xD8. Whether the two tables serve different consumers or different CPU variants is not determinable from this packet.

classes.name: AMD3DNowMathDispatchTable
classes.responsibility: CPU-guarded function-pointer table of 3DNow/MMX math routines (matrix multiply/transpose/inverse, quaternion product/composition/rotation, vector normalize/blend/negate, barycentric/cubic/bezier/quadrilinear interpolation, axis-angle and transform-matrix construction). The 57-slot fill runs only when CPU feature bits 0x20 and 0x80 are set; bits 0x100 and 0x200 gate five slot overrides (slots 15, 18, 24, 38, 39) whose fields list both the base and override routines. Returns the CPU feature flags from sub_5171D0.

classes.name: ScalarMathDispatchTable
classes.responsibility: Eight-entry math dispatch table (slots 0..7 at offsets 0x0..0x1C) populated with Vec2AffineTransform, sub_517569, sub_517653, F_44MatrixMultiply, F_44MatrixMultiply_7899, Mat2x2Mul, sub_5175F4 and VectorNormalize. Called from sub_50FEA7.

classes.name: FixedPointLookupTableSet
classes.responsibility: Object owning a sub-struct at this+0x1A0 that holds four 1024-DWORD lookup tables (at sub-struct offsets 0x8/0xC/0x10/0x14). The tables are allocated through vtable slot 0 at *(this+0x4) with allocator arguments (this, 1, 1024), then filled in a single loop with arithmetic-progression sequences: table 0 ascending (v9 += 91881 stored as v9 >> 16), table 1 ascending (v8 += 116130 stored as v8 >> 16), table 2 marching downward from global unk_5B6900 (v4 -= 46802), table 3 descending (i -= 22554).

state_machines.name: ColorPackWorkFlag
transitions: Idle -> PackPending: packing pass runs only while both the work flag (this+0x108C) and enable flag (this+0x1090) are non-zero
PackPending -> Idle: packing loop clears the work flag (this+0x108C) to 0 after processing

interfaces.name: VersionAdaptiveDispatchTable
interfaces.purpose: Version- and CPU-adaptive function-pointer dispatch tables installed once at startup by sub_50FEA7. Selects among the SSE, SSE-alt, 3DNow/MMX and scalar math tables (each filled by its init function) and provides the global audio dispatch slots consumed by the NetworkAudioDispatch thunks.

compatibility_contracts.name: DirectXSurfaceFormatDispatch
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must accept a format code at descriptor+0x4, allocate a per-code-sized surface object, keep it at descriptor+0x8, run its per-code constructor, return NULL for unrecognized codes, and invoke the vtable slot-3 (+12) virtual when the constructed object's +0x10 dword is non-null.

compatibility_contracts.name: StagingSurfaceFormatMatch
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must reallocate the staging buffer (16*width bytes) whenever the destination surface format (this+0x8) differs from the source format (*(*(this+0x8)+0x8)), record the matched format, return 0 on success and -2147024882 when allocation fails.

compatibility_contracts.name: NetworkAudioDispatchSlot
compatibility_contracts.description: Audio callers dispatch through version-adaptive slots; a replacement must initialize the shared function table (sub_50FEA7 semantics) before invoking the slot implementation stored at off_5D7890 / off_5D7848 / off_5D787C.

compatibility_contracts.name: SIMDMathDispatchTables
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must install the SSE, SSE-alt, 3DNow/MMX and scalar function-pointer tables with the slot-to-routine assignments captured in the class fields. The 3DNow fill is gated on CPU feature bits 0x20/0x80, with five slot overrides gated on bits 0x100/0x200.

compatibility_contracts.name: VertexColorPackLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Vertex-color packing must run only while both the work flag (this+0x108C) and enable flag (this+0x1090) are set, then clear the work flag; the two pack shift amounts are held at this+0x1094 and this+0x1098.

compatibility_contracts.name: OSFeatureDetection
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must reproduce the GetVersionExA / CPUID / IsProcessorFeaturePresent based platform and CPU-feature detection that drives dispatch-table selection.

compatibility_contracts.name: FixedPointLookupTables
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must allocate four 1024-DWORD lookup tables through vtable slot 0 (allocator arguments (this, 1, 1024)) and fill them with the four arithmetic-progression sequences described in the FixedPointLookupTableSet responsibility.

RenderBufferVertexAllocator (0x0050A7E1): the global loc_59C578 is listed but absent from the raw source; the semantics of the base count / derived even count window and of the format tag 0x59565955 are unknown; the mirrored 8/0 field assignments and this+0x1088 are inferred.

VertexColorPackRGBto16 (0x0050A92D): which conversion-coefficient global backs which constant is not provable from the packet; fields this+0x107C and this+0x1084 are accessed per the extractor but their roles are unknown.

NetworkAudioSend thunks (0x0050C391, 0x0050D690, 0x0050E302): the indirect slot implementations are not identified; the callee entries callee:0x0050C391 / callee:0x0050D690 are self-loop artifacts, not recursive calls; the two-argument variant's relationship to the other thunks is unestablished; the float argument a2's meaning (volume/pan/time) is unknown.

SSE/SSE-alt table initializers (0x005170C0, 0x00516FB0): the owning object and dispatch convention are not evidenced; slot roles are inferred from routine names; whether the two tables serve different consumers or CPU variants is not determinable.

TableInitWithArithmeticProgression (0x0051C5A3): the vtable-slot-0 allocator at *(this+0x4) is unresolved; the intended semantic content of the four arithmetic sequences (fixed-point >>16 values, pointer-derived values from unk_5B6900) is unknown (existing analysis guesses wheel/suspension data, unconfirmed); the sub-struct owner type is unknown; the loop trip count is derived from the progression bounds, not a packet literal.
